evidence.title: J. Peter May → Jennifer Wilson: PhD supervision
evidence.summary: Wilson’s CV explicitly lists Peter May as secondary adviser for her June 2014 Chicago PhD, with Benson Farb as primary adviser.

sources.label: J. Peter May — current institutional profile

notes: Secondary doctoral advising is preserved explicitly; this is not a claim that May was the sole or primary adviser. This is a documented historical academic advising relationship. Current institutional affiliations were checked separately; the relationship does not establish admissions committee membership, current contact, letter strength, or willingness to supervise.
